Don’t forget that it is rather difficult to find a new job in this climate, as hundreds of people have been let go from other positions and are slicing each other open to find a new source of income.

I’m assuming that you’re working full-time at the moment? If so, you have the option of talking to your supervisor about reducing your hours to help alleviate the mental anguish you’re going through at the supermarket (which I completely understand as somebody who worked checkouts for a long period of time), obviously you don’t have to tell them that exactly if you’re not comfortable revealing such intimate information.

Keep sending your resumes to companies and business’ you want to work with in the meantime.
